label: Stamping conductances
subgoals: Add the conductance to both diagonal entries of its nodes
Subtract the conductance from the two off-diagonal entries
Drop the ground row and column from every stamp

label: Stamping voltage sources and inductors
subgoals: Add a branch-current unknown for each voltage source
Add a branch-current unknown for each inductor
Count the non-ground nodes plus the added branch currents

label: Companion models for capacitors
subgoals: Replace the capacitor derivative by a backward difference
Stamp C over h as a conductance between the capacitor nodes
Stamp C over h times the previous voltage as a history current
